contribution_types.description:
Bhavana further elaborated on getting to oneness (_Seva - proper mental frame to be in when contributing in DAO_)

Self (1) + Divinity, aka choiceless awareness (1) = 2 

To get to 1 one of the two must be removed from the equation 

Not-self, aka Anatta (0) + Divinity, choiceless awareness (1) = 1

When anybody is doing anything make sure Nobody is Doing Nothing

Time taken by her to clarify this nuanced point: 30 minutes ‎<This message was edited>
Time taken by Bhavana to help further clarify this very nuanced point that is very critical for the philosophical foundation described in our white paper is 30 minutes ‎<This message was edited>
Time taken by her to explain the concept of *Namaskar* _(I bow to the divinity in you)_ last year during zoom session was 15 minutes ‎<This message was edited>

Had dinner with Bhavana, @41765737357, @41799155602 and @41765663130 last week for 3 hours 

_Key insights_

- it is possible to have *Integrity* (_core value_) without need for Transparency (_not core value_)

_Follow up action_

- future useful insights gathered that are not tokenizable will no longer be shared within these channels (_DM me if you are keen to find out where the category of untokenized  insights are published and shared_)

- ⁠this will further reduce the amount of post within our WhatsApp channels 

- ⁠if two or more DAO members are present, visual submissions will no longer be a requirement to prove that DAO contribution has transpired 

- ⁠Governors retain the right to request for proof when in doubt 

🙂🙏 ‎<This message was edited>

entries.contribution:
Generally spent today doing nothing much in terms of roadmap progress…

Bilal and his community wanted advisory inputs on Web3 technology stack, DAO growth and monetization and DAO tokenomics based on the RnD we have done so far regarding TrueSight DAO

Bhavana wanted advisory inputs on how to move into and live in a car based on the RnD I did in this area

Seems the insights generated so far is of value in one form or another to a very niche group of people but not really very valuable in general to most of the people 

And my sense is if it does at some point start becoming of some form of commercial interest, then all the other marketeers will just start piling into the bandwagon. The space will end up becoming so saturated, the insight will just end up being non-valuable commodity anyways 🤔🤣

Perhaps it’s a sign from the universe to Do Nothing for the current moment while exercising Anatman and Shunyata

In Stillness observe how much of the stuff to be done classified as being productive is actually what the larger ecosystem desires to manifest and how much of it is just wishful thinking resultant from attachment to one form of mental construct or another

narrative.text: Bhavana contributed 4 hours of human effort to TrueSight DAO in January 2024, earning rewards through the 100TDG For every 1 hour of human effort category.
